name: Kaamnaa
description: The show focuses on the emotional journey of Manav, a simple, loving and devoted husband of Akanksha and a doting father of a 6-year-old, Yatharth. Manav and Akanksha have different points of view on principles and ambition. What will happen when the successful Vaibhav Kapoor enters their lives?

videos.title: Middle-Class Values
videos.overview: Manav and Akansha's views about success and happiness are poles apart. How will this married couple with conflicting ideologies coexist together?

videos.title: Broken Relationship
videos.overview: Manav and Akansha discuss the merits of divorce in a broken relationship. Vaibhav is obsessed with Akansha and is desperate to find out more about her.

videos.title: Zameer Ka Sauda
videos.overview: Manav's job is at risk when he refuses to support his senior's corrupt acts. Meanwhile, Vaibhav continues to collect more information about Akansha.

videos.title: Suspension Ki Talvaar
videos.overview: Manav and Akansha try to cheer up Yatharth while the threat of suspension looms over their heads. Can the Bajpai family find their way out of this problem?

videos.title: Manav's Promotion
videos.overview: Manav gets the opportunity of being promoted to a senior-level job in Indore. However, Akansha is against the idea of shifting there. Will Manav be able to convince her?

videos.title: Naya Sheher Nayi Shuruaat
videos.overview: Akansha agrees to shift to Indore and the Bajpais are on their way. However, a nasty surprise awaits Akansha when she arrives at her new home.

videos.title: Indori Swagat
videos.overview: Manav arranges a candlelight dinner for Akansha to make it up to her. Meanwhile, Akansha tries to adjust to her new life and starts setting up her home.

videos.title: Blast From The Past
videos.overview: Akansha is confronted by her past as her mother and sister come to visit her. Meanwhile, Manav's duty pits him against Vaibhav Kapoor and his company.

videos.title: Beeta Hua Kal
videos.overview: Sangini confronts Vaibhav and threatens to expose him in the media. Meanwhile, Akansha tells Manav about her rocky history with her family.

videos.title: Heere Ki Parakh
videos.overview: Akansha and Manav attend a pooja in their locality. Coincidentally, Vaibhav also arrives at the pooja as a special guest.

videos.title: Miss Indore
videos.overview: Akansha is distressed as everyone at the pooja finds out about her past as Miss Indore. Meanwhile, Manav and Vaibhav have a run-in with each other, but things start on an unpleasant note.

videos.title: Vaibhav Ki Kaamnaa
videos.overview: The Bajpais decide to go on a tour of Indore. Meanwhile, Vaibhav hires a professional to find out more about Akansha.

videos.title: Khatirdaari Ka Mauka
videos.overview: Manav's senior takes him to Vaibhav's house to work out a deal between them. Meanwhile, Akansha's past comes to haunt her once again.

videos.title: Sapno Ka Bojh
videos.overview: Manav tries to talk about Akanshas past with her, but she is not willing to share. Meanwhile, Vaibhav gets a new lead that helps him find out more information about Akansha.

videos.title: Following The Rules
videos.overview: Akansha breaks down in front of Manav and tells him about her insecurities. Meanwhile, Vaibhav learns a key detail about Akansha from her ex-manager.

videos.title: Manav's Surprise
videos.overview: Manav plans a surprise for Akansha to cheer her up. Meanwhile, Vaibhav asks Rane to find out about Akanshas family.

videos.title: Naye Ghar Ki Khoj
videos.overview: Manav plans to buy a new house for Akansha. The Bajpais head out for house hunting. Meanwhile, Vaibhav has a run-in with the woman of his dreams.

videos.title: Sentimental Value
videos.overview: Vaibhav tasks Tomar with monitoring Akansha and following her every step. Meanwhile, Manav asks his boss for a loan to buy the new flat.

videos.title: Manhoos Bungalow
videos.overview: Akansha comes across her old bungalow, which brings back memories from her past. Now she wants Manav to purchase that bungalow instead. What will Manav do?

videos.title: Kimati Yaadein
videos.overview: Akansha approaches Vaibhav Kapoor to enquire about the Bungalow. Will things fall in place according to Vaibhav's plan?

videos.title: Out Of Budget
videos.overview: Vaibhav agrees to sell the bungalow to Akansha. Now she only needs Manav's approval to seal the deal. But will Manav agree?

videos.title: Sapno Ka Ghar
videos.overview: Manav is not willing to buy the bungalow for Akansha. Meanwhile, Vaibhav accidentally sends an embarrassing text message to Akansha, confessing his feelings. What will happen now?

videos.title: Sarkari Naukar
videos.overview: Manav refuses to take any favours from Vaibhav to purchase the bungalow. Vaibhav feels insulted and uses some underhanded tactics to get back at him.

videos.title: Manav Ke Usool
videos.overview: Akansha gets a panic attack when she finds out that Vaibhav is selling the bungalow to someone else. With time running out and an acute shortage of cash, how will Manav fulfil Akansha's wish?

videos.title: Rishwat Ka Phanda
videos.overview: Manav is forced to take the bribe money to fulfil Akansha's demands. But now, he can't even look at himself in the mirror. What will happen next?

videos.title: Clean Bowled
videos.overview: Manav is unable to live with himself, knowing that he has taken a bribe. He decides to return the money and clear his conscience. How will Akansha react when she hears about this decision?

videos.title: Akansha's Secret Santa
videos.overview: Akansha and Riya arrive at Vaibhav's party and get treated like VIPs. Meanwhile, Manav finds a way of arranging money for the bungalow. Will Manav's efforts be enough for Akansha?

videos.title: Dil Ka Khel Dimag Se
videos.overview: Manav arranges the money for the bungalow and locks the deal at Vaibhav's office. Vaibhav comes to the bungalow unannounced to meet Akansha and walks straight into the bedroom. What will happen when Manav sees this?

videos.title: Bin Bulaya Mehmaan
videos.overview: Manav is in a rage when he sees Vaibhav Kapoor in his bedroom. Vaibhav feels humiliated by Manav and vows to get back at him. What will he do to retaliate?

videos.title: Modelling Contract
videos.overview: Manav and Akansha face another crisis as the costs for renovation begin to pile up. Meanwhile, Akansha's ex-agent, Maya Xaviers, offers Akansha a new modelling contract. Is this all a part of Vaibhav's plan?

videos.title: Dosti Ka Haath
videos.overview: Manav warns Vaibhav to stay away from him and his family. However, things are starting to look up for Vaibhav as Akansha signs the contract.

videos.title: Daraar Ka Beej
videos.overview: Akansha makes a comeback on the modelling scene by signing a contract with Vaibhav Kapoor. Meanwhile, Manav gets threatened by loan sharks to repay the loan as soon as possible. What will he do?

videos.title: Pita Ka Vaada
videos.overview: Manav catches onto Vaibhav's plan and doesn't want Akansha to work with him anymore. Manav decides to sell his car to pay for Yatharth's school trip. What will happen next?

videos.title: Yatharth's Trip
videos.overview: Manav somehow manages to sell his old car to send Yatharth for the trip. Meanwhile, Vaibhav calls up Akansha and delivers some bad news. What will happen now?

videos.title: Fame Ka Zaika
videos.overview: Akansha panics when she sees her fame slipping away. She resents Manav for his actions and behaviour. Will things turn out in Vaibhav's favour?

videos.title: Out Of Track
videos.overview: Akansha is distressed after losing the modelling contract. At Akansha's request, Vaibhav sits down with Manav and hopes to make a deal with him.

videos.title: Vaibhav's Offer
videos.overview: Vaibhav extends a hand of friendship towards Manav and wants to put their differences behind. Will Manav accept Vaibhav's friendship?

videos.title: Dinner With Vaibhav Kapoor
videos.overview: Manav agrees to accept Vaibhav's offer and put his differences aside for Akansha's happiness. To celebrate this deal, Vaibhav invites Manav and his family for dinner at his house.

videos.title: Manav Ka Shak
videos.overview: Manav notices that something is off in Vaibhav's behaviour around Akansha. Will Manav finally catch onto Vaibhav's true intent?

videos.title: Zor Azmaish
videos.overview: Manav pieces together past events, and his suspicion turn into surety. Meanwhile, Vaibhav decides to take a different approach to achieve his ultimate goal.

videos.title: Niyat Ka Sawal
videos.overview: Vaibhav wins over Akansha with his words and his business pitch. Meanwhile, Pathan pressurizes Manav to repay the loan within two days. Will Manav give his approval to Akansha for working with Vaibhav?

videos.title: Once In A Lifetime Opportunity
videos.overview: Akansha is distraught when Manav prohibits her from working with Vaibhav. Meanwhile, Manav passes out from the pressure of paying back the loan and gets admitted to a hospital. How will the Bajpais arrange such a large sum of money now?

videos.title: Akansha Takes Charge
videos.overview: Akansha signs the contract with Vaibhav to pay off the loan. Manav is shocked and enraged to learn about Akansha's actions. What will happen now?

videos.title: Natak Ki Shuruaat
videos.overview: Akansha begins rehearsals for the stage play. Manav reaches the rehearsal hall, where he gets insulted and is told to leave. Will Vaibhav succeed in tearing down Manav's life?

videos.title: Vaibhav's Cupid
videos.overview: Maya decides to play cupid for Vaibhav and Akansha. Meanwhile, Akansha forgets to inform Manav about picking up Yatharth from school, and Yatharth gets stuck outside the house.

videos.title: Loose Character
videos.overview: Differences between Manav and Akansha continue to grow. Meanwhile, Maya plays her tricks to bring Vaibhav closer to Akansha.

videos.title: Method Acting
videos.overview: Vaibhav takes over as the male lead of the play. Akansha starts visiting Vaibhav's house for the rehearsals. Meanwhile, Yatharth and Manav have a tough time coming to terms with these new circumstances.

videos.title: Adhura Rishta
videos.overview: Yatharth joins the new school where he gets bullied by the kids. Meanwhile, Vaibhav grows closer to Akansha by using his tricks.

videos.title: Pyaar Aur Takraar
videos.overview: Manav gets a call from Yatharth's school and he rushes there. Vaibhav's plan seems to be working as Akansha starts seeing him in a different light.

videos.title: Bharose Ki Dorr
videos.overview: Akansha feels horrible about her neglectful actions when she learns about Yatharth's injury. She promises Manav that she will always be faithful to him and her family. But will Manav trust her words?

videos.title: Fuel To The Fire
videos.overview: Akansha slaps Vaibhav and leaves the play after he tries to kiss her. However, Vaibhav is confident that Akansha will return to him. Is this all a part of Vaibhav's master plan?

videos.title: Love Struck
videos.overview: Vaibhav is sure that Akansha is in love with him, and he invites her home to prove his point. Will Vaibhav's assessment be true, or will he stand corrected?

videos.title: Dil Ki Baazi
videos.overview: Vaibhav finally confesses his love for Akansha. He offers her to begin a new life with him. Between her family and Vaibhav, what will Akansha choose?

videos.title: Sapno Ki Chalaang
videos.overview: Manav heads out to confront Vaibhav at his office. Meanwhile, Akansha chooses to live with Vaibhav and accepts her feelings for him. What will happen now?

videos.title: Yatharth's Birthday
videos.overview: Akansha agrees to stay back for Yatharth's birthday party. How long can Akansha and Manav hide the truth about their crumbling marriage?

videos.title: Paisa Aur Pyaar
videos.overview: Vaibhav comes to pick up Akansha, and she leaves with him. Manav is overwhelmed with emotions of anger and loss, while Vaibhav welcomes Akansha into his house.

videos.title: Marzi Aur Majboori
videos.overview: Vaibhav and Akansha begin a new chapter in their life together. Meanwhile, Manav contemplates how to tell Yatharth about Akansha's truth.

videos.title: Honeymoon Phase
videos.overview: Manav has a hard time dealing with the responsibilities of a single working parent. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha prepare to go on their honeymoon.

videos.title: Bajpai Family Problems
videos.overview: Now that Vaibhav has attained his goal, he decides to cancel the play. Meanwhile, Manav and Yatharth struggle to move on with their lives without Akansha.

videos.title: Magic Hands
videos.overview: Yatharth gets hospitalized after getting into a terrible accident. Manav tells Akansha that he will never let her get back into Yatharth's life. Can Manav handle the weight of the household all by himself?

videos.title: Yatharth's New Teacher
videos.overview: Manav takes up the responsibility of teaching Yatharth in Akansha's absence. Meanwhile, Vaibhav cuts Akansha off from her past and tries to control her life. What will happen now?

videos.title: Queen Akansha Kapoor
videos.overview: Kaushal spots Akansha with Vaibhav, and questions Manav about it. Meanwhile, Vaibhav boosts Akansha's ego by making her a part of his business.

videos.title: A New Low For The Bajpai Family
videos.overview: Yatharth learns the truth about his mother, and Manav gets thrown into jail for beating up Kaushal. How will father and son navigate through these dire circumstances?

videos.title: A Golden Dawn
videos.overview: Vaibhav gains Karan's favour with bribes. Kaushal takes back his complaint and frees Manav from jail. Yatharth wipes his father's tears and decides to take care of him on his own.

videos.title: Masoom Sach
videos.overview: Akansha's brother approves her decision of moving in with Vaibhav. Meanwhile, Akansha comes to Yatharth's school to meet him.

videos.title: Yatharth's Mental Health
videos.overview: Manav gets a call from the school to meet Sakshi Verma, the school counsellor. Sakshi informs Manav about Yatharth's deteriorating mental health.

videos.title: Welcome To The New CEO
videos.overview: Karan tries to take Yatharth away and make him meet Akansha. However, Manav confronts him in time and gives him a stern warning. Meanwhile, Vaibhav decides to make Akansha the new CEO of his company.

videos.title: Burning Bridges
videos.overview: Akansha comes to Yatharth's school to meet him, but Yatharth runs away to avoid her. Meanwhile, Manav confronts Akansha and warns her to stay away from Yatharth.

videos.title: Best Father In The World
videos.overview: Manav and Yatharth have an emotional confrontation, and they decide to live their life happily without Akansha.  Meanwhile, the school counsellor Sakshi Verma invites Akansha and Manav for a much-needed therapy session.

videos.title: Out Of Hand
videos.overview: Things quickly get out of hand during Manav and Akansha's counselling session. Akansha arrives at the colony to meet Yatharth. But instead of greeting her with open arms, Yatharth runs away from her and locks himself inside the house.

videos.title: Bewafai Ki Saza
videos.overview: Akansha's mother gets hospitalised after having a heart attack. Meanwhile, Yatharth and Manav throw a party and announce that they will be a family of two from now on.

videos.title: Odd One Out
videos.overview: Manav and Yatharth make a shocking announcement during the colony party. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha arrive at Yatharth's school to take him home.

videos.title: Yatharth Disowns Akansha
videos.overview: Akansha reaches the school but gets a very cold reaction from Yatharth. Akansha swears to get revenge on Manav for turning Yatharth against her.

videos.title: Gaslighting
videos.overview: Vaibhav threatens to take Yatharth away from Manav. However, Yatharth is clear that he wants to stay with Manav. What will Vaibhav do to separate the father and son?

videos.title: Termination Of The Student Counselor
videos.overview: Vaibhav pulls some strings and terminates Sakshi from her job. Manav and Yatharth arrive at Sakshi's house, where they learn this shocking truth. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha celebrate their win.

videos.title: Ek Naya Toofan
videos.overview: Sakshi loses her job and her house in a single night. Vaibhav and Akansha are busy celebrating this victory while Manav and Yatharth search for Sakshi. What does fate have in store for them next?

videos.title: Insult To Injury
videos.overview: Akansha insults Sakshi after getting her terminated from her job. Meanwhile, Aisha and Yatharth meet with the school chairman in hopes of getting Sakshi her job back. Will they be able to convince him?

videos.title: Golden Touch
videos.overview: Yatharth and Aisha are unable to get Sakshi's termination reversed. Meanwhile, Manav goes out to look for Sakshi as well. Will he be able to find her?

videos.title: Mantra For Happiness
videos.overview: Manav and Yatharth convince Sakshi to stay with them at their home. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha prepare for the school board meeting to gain Yatharth's custody.

videos.title: Yatharth's Guardianship
videos.overview: The battle to determine Yatharth's true guardian gets underway. Will Manav's love win over Akansha's greed?

videos.title: Sole Guardian
videos.overview: Manav and Akansha raise their points in front of the board to gain the upper hand. The board decides to take a vote to make the final decision. Will their verdict be in Manav's favour?

videos.title: Khushaal Ghar
videos.overview: The school board surprisingly votes in favour of Manav and Yatharth. Father and son decide to celebrate while Vaibhav and Akansha are left to lick their wounds. Will Vaibhav give up after this defeat?

videos.title: Victory Celebration
videos.overview: The celebration begins at the Bajpai house. Yatharth and Aisha honour Sakshi on the occasion of women's day. Meanwhile, Vaibhav and Akansha also arrive at the party uninvited.

videos.title: Yatharth Ki Strength
videos.overview: Vaibhav and Akansha arrive at the Bajpai house and wish to meet Yatharth. Manav and the others motivate Yatharth to face his fears head-on. Will Yatharth be able to take a stand against his own mother?

videos.title: By Hook Or By Crook
videos.overview: Akansha arrives at Yatharth's school and forcefully takes him away with her. Manav finds out, and he contacts the police. Will Manav be able to find Yatharth?

videos.title: A Sore Loser
videos.overview: Manav receives the news that Yatharth and Akansha got into an ugly accident. Manav rushes to check on them at the accident site. What will happen next?

videos.title: Search For Yatharth
videos.overview: Manav and the others search for Yatharth near the accident site. Meanwhile, Akansha kidnaps Yatharth and tries to rekindle her relationship with him.

videos.title: Manav Saves Akansha
videos.overview: Manav walks out of a burning building with Akansha in his arms. Manav gets convinced not to file an FIR against Akansha so that it doesn't affect Yatharth's mental health. Later, Vaibhav yells at Akansha for making stupid decisions.

videos.title: Yatharth's Nightmares
videos.overview: Yatharth's nightmare makes him wet the bed again. Akansha tries to woo Vaibhav by making breakfast but he tells her that she needs to get rid of her middle-class tendencies.

videos.title: Negligence At Work
videos.overview: In Vaibhav's absence, Akansha tries to show off her office to Manav, but right then, Rane comes with the news of a mishap. Manav hears this and gets in touch with Kaushal, while Rane tells Akansha to take this seriously.
